title: VulnEx CVE Schema
description: Schema for a single Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) record in the VulnEx database.

cveId.description: Primary unique identifier for the vulnerability (e.g., CVE-YYYY-NNNN+).

published.description: The date the CVE was published, in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: A textual description of the vulnerability.

severityLevel.description: Categorical severity rating for the vulnerability.

productName.description: The name of the affected product.

productVersions.description: Standardized array of affected version ranges.

start.description: The starting version of the affected range.

end.description: The ending version of the affected range.

s_type.description: Inclusion type for the start version ('i' = inclusive, 'e' = exclusive).

e_type.description: Inclusion type for the end version ('i' = inclusive, 'e' = exclusive).
